title: Yanfly CTB turn order preview edits

posts.author: ChasingtheGale
posts.body:
This is kind of a long shot. I am working on a game using ctb.
http://www.yanfly.moe/wiki/Battle_System_-_CTB_(YEP)
I like Yanfly's out of all the others I've tried, however, it has one feature that I would really like to see and don't know how to edit on or where to start with it.
It does this little up tick for the enemy you have targeted but not where it will be forced to move or where the battler will go after the skill.
I need a preview of where the battler will end up in the order or where an enemy will move to if they use a selected skill or ability.
Victor's engine does this by rearranging the sprites:
https://victorenginescripts.wordpress.com/rpg-maker-mv/conditional-turn-battle/
Olivia's octobattler does it by having a little above sprite appear (just a picture for you, the code is obfuscated)
Ideally, the target would be highlighted, the enemy forced movement would be indicated and the new battler position indicated before commitment.
I'd be fine with just transparent versions of the sprites but in their prospective places, or whatever will make this as easy to understand as possible.
